d: Very advanced night. Room in use of party in the house of Slender. In the background orchestra, in front of which table, which is clearing; on the one hand Guernite belief of jams, refreshments, liqueurs, etc. Falstaff, master Slender, mistress Slender, mistress Ford, Convitati, Sounders, and Servi.
Falstaff's room in the inn. Bardolf alone.
Falstaff and Bardolf.
Bardolf alone.
Windsor Road. Master Ford alone, traveling.
Room in Slender's house. Mistress Slender, indi mistress Ford with Falstaff's letter in his hand.
Master Ford, Master Slender and Bardolf from another side door.

Mistress Ford, Mistress Slender from the door, so they will have entered, and said. Women come out talking to each other without immediately realizing the presence of their husbands, who are watching them sideways.
Master Ford and master Slender.
Garden in the inn. Falstaff, then Bardolf hasty.
Falstaff and mistress Ford disguised as German.
Falstaff, then Bardolf, and then Master Ford, disguised.
Master Ford alone.
Room of Mistress Ford, with workable alcove. Mistress Ford, Mistress Slender, Betty and Servi, who carry a large basket, and lay it in a song.
Mistress Ford, Falstaff, then Betty behind the scene, then Mistress Slender.
Mistress Ford, Mistress Slender, Master Ford, Master Slender with Amici's follow-up.
Mistress Ford's room, Mistress Ford, Mistress Slender, and Betty.
Falstaff's room in the tavern. Falstaff's clothes are laid out to dry. Falstaff as a tear room, in the Bardolf.
Falstaff alone.
Bardolf, the above, in Betty's name.
Falstaff alone.
Bardolf, and the above.
Inn garden. Master Ford disguised, in Falstaff.
Master Ford alone.
Room of mistress Ford with alcove: on one side the basket as in the first act. Mistress Ford and Betty.
Mistress Ford, and Falstaff sneaking in.
Said, and Mistress Slender inside, what then arose.
Mistress Ford and Mistress Slender.

Master Ford, Master Slender, followed by Friends, from the middle door: the Servants from a side door with the basket: the Mistress Ford, and finally Mistress Slender leading Falstaff dressed as an old woman.
Falstaff's room in the tavern. Falstaff dressed as an old woman, then master Ford disguised.
Master Ford, then Falstaff, returning.

Dark night. Wild place near the castle of Windsor. In the middle of great oak. Master Slender, Betty and follow of Women dressed as fairies and Men dressed strangely, with lit lanterns and torches turned off in hand.
That being said, Master Ford, Mistress Ford, and Mistress Slender.
Falstaff with deer head, indi mistress Ford, and mistress Slender mistress Ford.
Mistress Ford as queen of fairies, Betty as fairy, other fairies and strange figures with torches on and the above.
Falstaff, master Slender, master Ford, mistress Slender, mistress Ford, Betty, and Séguito partly exposed, and later.
